name.baseName: Electricity grid mix, technology mix, consumption mix at consumer, Low Voltage

dataSetInformation.common:synonyms: Rete mix elettrico, mix tecnologico, consumo al consumatore, Basso Voltaggio
dataSetInformation.common:generalComment:
Dataset developed according to Arcadia project Methodology (Report: “Metodologia per gli studi di filiera della Banca Dati italiana LCA”). LCA study of electricity consumption from Italian electric mix (Report: “Filiera di produzione del mix elettrico italiano”).
The dataset refers to the consumption of 1 kWh of electricity from electrical mix in low voltage, in Italy, and it is representative of the processing technologies commonly used for this purpose. The dataset consists of 2 processes: 1) Electricity grid mix, technology mix, consumption mix at consumer, High Voltage (percentage contribution to the whole dataset: 92%). 2) Electricity production, low voltage, photovoltaic, IT (percentage contribution to the whole dataset: 8%).

referenceToExternalDocumentation.common:shortDescription:
Gabriella Fiorentino, Simona Scalbi, Antonietta Cerbone, Giuliana Ansanelli, Marco Giammartini, Amalia Zucaro. Filiera di produzione del mix elettrico italiano.
Background datasets from EcoInvent database cut-off (v.3.7.1) were used for the LCA study.

time.common:timeRepresentativenessDescription: This dataset has been considered valid until 2026, since no main changes have occurred in the electricity mix in Italy in the investigated year.

technology.technologyDescriptionAndIncludedProcesse:
The dataset (1 kWh of electricity from electrical mix in low voltage, in Italy) refers to a system that includes high voltage electricity consumption multiplied by high to medium and medium to low grid losses, and low voltage electricity production (from photovoltaic mix) that is multiplied by low voltage losses only. The primary data come from Terna and ARERA.
For the LCA study, background datasets from EcoInvent database 3.7.1 cut-off were used.
technology.technologicalApplicability: Electricity from Italian electricity mix sold to the Italian electric grid.

dataSourcesTreatmentAndRepresentativenes.dataCutOffAndCompletenessPrinciples: Production of equipment and infrastructures is not included, except for the background system

review.common:reviewDetails: The review was performed in compliance with Arcadia Metodology: “Metodologia per gli studi di filiera della Banca Dati italiana LCA” and ISO 14040-44 norms. The dataset has been assessed limited to the foreground data collected during the supply chain studies. Each dataset has been evaluated based on the following 4 criteria: 1. Technological Representativeness; 2. Time Representativeness; 3. Geographical Representativeness; 4. Reliability (A) In this contest the Reliability is very good.
review.common:otherReviewDetails: The study was judged by the reviewer as compliant with both ISO 14040-44 and Arcadia methodology.
